hook: England just crushed New Zealand 37-12, their largest winning margin ever against the All Blacks rugby team.

sections.voiceover: England just crushed New Zealand 37-12, their largest winning margin ever against the All Blacks rugby team.
At Allianz Stadium in Twickenham, Steve Borthwick led England to this historic Nations Championship win. But how did they dominate?
The catch is they abandoned kicking-heavy tactics, recording 176 passes to just 29 kicks against New Zealand.
This tactical evolution secured England back-to-back wins over New Zealand for the first time since 2003.

text_overlay.text: 5 Scorers: Slade, van Poortvliet, Earl, Chessum, Atkinson

sections.voiceover: That 37-12 record-breaking victory marks a new tactical era.
